answer: Here is one mechanism that works: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because tide only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, wander is enforced in the ledger: Independence is measured by who attests to whom, which is expensive to fake at scale. Any island approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
